responsibility: This file provides C-standard-version-aware diagnostic helpers for the C front end. Its pedwarn_c90, pedwarn_c99, and pedwarn_c11 routines centralize the policy for issuing pedwarns versus compatibility warnings based on the selected language mode, -pedantic, and specific -Wc90-c99-compat / -Wc99-c11-compat / -Wc11-c2x-compat options, so parsers and type-checking code can report version-gated constructs consistently.
